foundation.title: The Shugaosha Way — Foundation
foundation.p1: Our core facial correction service, focused closely on restoring facial balance, alignment and harmony.
foundation.p2: Using precise, layered rebalancing, it works with the face as a whole to help correct visible imbalance, refine the contours and support a more lifted, firmer and three-dimensional appearance.
foundation.p3: Many clients can see a visible change from their first session, with the face often appearing more balanced, centred and refined, with clearer contours and a fresher, more youthful overall appearance.

lift.title: The Shugaosha Lift
lift.p1: The Shugaosha Lift is a separate hands-on service that works progressively through the upper body, shoulders, neck, head and face, helping release built-up tension in connected areas that can influence how the face is supported.
lift.p2: By easing tension through these areas, many clients can feel a difference from their first session, with greater openness, ease and freedom of movement through the shoulders, neck and head.
lift.p3: The facial work places a stronger focus on lifting, helping the lifting effect feel better supported, more stable and longer-lasting over time.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common Questions

items.question: Which Shugaosha service should I choose?
items.answer:
For first-time clients, we recommend starting with The Shugaosha Way — Foundation. It is our core facial correction service and allows us to first work closely with your facial balance, alignment and contours.

Once that foundation has been established, The Shugaosha Lift can be introduced if you would like to work more broadly through the upper body, shoulders, neck, head and face, with a stronger focus on release and supporting the lifting effect.

items.question: Can I see a visible change after one session?
items.answer:
Many clients can see a visible change from their first session.

With The Shugaosha Way — Foundation, this may include a more balanced, lifted and refined facial appearance, with clearer contours.

With The Shugaosha Lift, clients may also feel a noticeable difference through the shoulders, neck and head, with a greater sense of release and openness.

items.question: How long do the results last?
items.answer:
How long the results last can vary depending on factors such as facial tension, posture, stress and everyday habits.

Ongoing sessions help support the balance and changes that have already been built, while regular maintenance is recommended to help keep the results more stable over time.

A simple way to think about it is a little like going to the gym — if you want to maintain the progress, regular maintenance is important.

items.question: How long is each session and why?
items.answer:
Each session is approximately 45–60 minutes.

Facial tissues can become overworked if unnecessary pressure is applied for too long, so we carefully adjust the duration, pace and pressure according to what your face needs, rather than overworking the area. This allows us to work effectively while avoiding unnecessary stress on the tissues.

items.question: How many sessions do I need?
items.answer:
Many clients can see a visible change from their first session.

For a more balanced and settled result, we generally recommend around 4–5 sessions initially, with each session building on the previous one and helping the facial balance, alignment and contours become more established over time.

After that, the frequency can be adjusted according to your individual progress and needs.

items.question: Can I have a session after Botox, fillers or other injectables?
items.answer:
We recommend waiting at least 4 weeks after Botox.

For fillers, Sculptra or other injectable treatments, we recommend waiting at least 6 months before having a session.

If you have had any of the above procedures, please contact us before making a booking. We’ll first confirm whether it is suitable for you to proceed.

items.question: Who may not be suitable for a Shugaosha session?
items.answer:
A Shugaosha session may not be suitable if you have active skin inflammation, eczema, open wounds, recent facial surgery or thread lifts.

For male clients, heavy facial hair or a full beard can also make it more difficult for us to work directly with the face and may reduce how clearly visible changes can be seen.

If any of these apply to you, please contact us before booking so we can confirm whether it is suitable to proceed.
